unit: Unit 1: Linear Algebra: Vector Spaces, Subspaces, Linear Independence, Basis, Rank, Projections & Inner Products
Unit 2: Matrix Decompositions: Eigendecomposition, Diagonalization, Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Matrix Approximations
Unit 3: Vector & Matrix Calculus: Gradients, Directional Derivatives, Jacobian, Hessian, Chain Rule, Backpropagation Theory
Unit 4: Continuous Optimization: Gradient Descent, Stochastic GD, Momentum, Newton-Raphson, Convex Optimization, KKT Conditions
Unit 5: Dimensionality Reduction & Probabilistic Modeling: Principal Component Analysis (PCA), MLE, MAP & Density Estimation
